title: ED tech competency checklist, mapped to Rounds
body:
A composite of US hospital ED technician / patient care technician job descriptions and orientation competency checklists, cross-walked against the **NHA CPT** (Certified Patient Care Technician/Assistant) and **CET** (Certified EKG Technician) exam outlines and **AHA BLS Provider**. Every row names the Rounds module and lesson that teaches it.

Module ids are shortened here: `role` = ed-role, `hired` = ed-getting-hired, `epic` = ed-epic-charting, `triage` = ed-triage, `ekg` = ed-ekg, `phleb` = ed-phlebotomy, `proc` = ed-procedures, `wound` = ed-wound-ortho, `mon` = ed-monitoring, `codes` = ed-codes-acls-pals, `pres` = ed-presentations, `psych` = ed-psych-deescalation, `span` = ed-medical-spanish, `safety` = ed-safety, `care` = ed-patient-care, `equip` = ed-equipment-respiratory. An `x` after the module means the extension file (`.ext.json`).

## 1. Role, scope and orientation

## Still thin after this pass

- **Pediatric vital sign technique by age** as a hands-on skill is spread across triage, monitoring and codes rather than taught once.
- **Specimen collection beyond blood and urine** — sputum, stool, wound and nasopharyngeal swab technique — is only touched in passing.
- **Height, weight and true dosing weight** capture in the ED has no dedicated lesson.
- **Basic musculoskeletal range of motion and positioning for contracture prevention** is out of ED scope by design and is not covered.
